text.en:
The rate of cash dividends to be declared by government
owned or controlled corporations under Section 17 of Executive Order No.
518, S. of 1979, is hereby increased from at least five percent (5%) to at least ten
percent (10%) of their respective net earnings of each year..

This Executive Order shall not apply to the Government
Service Insurance System, the Social Security System, and those government
owned or controlled corporations whose profit distribution is provided for by
their respective charters or by special law.

2

This Ex~cutive Order shall take effect (15) days following
its publication in a national newspaper of general circulation.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 24th day of April, in the year of Our
Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety.
